concept: Website and CRM built as one, as a red-and-blue checking pencil, rendered in 3D (Blender). One hexagonal pencil on bone paper, red one end and blue the other, foil-stamped WEBSITE, CRM and the Nexulabs wordmark across the join, shot from the front left three ways with what it has just written behind it. The red point: new enquiry, this end is your website. The blue point: quoted, booked, done, each ticked, this end is your CRM. Then the join, red into blue under the wordmark, and one line on the paper that changes colour with it: one pencil. Bone paper, pencil red, pencil blue, cedar and ink; Geist.
